attempts.summary: Configured node1, node2, node3 as a 3-member MariaDB Galera cluster on Alpine Linux (mariadb 11.4.12 + galera 26.4.13). Diagnosed and worked around a real donor-selection bug in the rsync SST helper on this platform combo (donor never launched the transfer) by switching wsrep_sst_method to mariabackup with wsrep_sst_auth. Verified multi-master write propagation across all members, verified availability + automatic resync when a member is taken down and brought back, and completed the mandatory sequential native-reboot protocol on all three nodes with boot-id proof and post-reboot cluster health/data verification.
